caption: The drawing depicts a bird, resembling a dove or pigeon, perched on a rounded, irregularly shaped base. The bird is rendered in shades of gray with darker accents to suggest the texture of feathers, and has a distinct, dark-circled eye and a defined beak. The base on which the bird stands is predominantly off-white or light gray, and features two red, berry-like objects and two green leaves attached to its front. The background is plain and uncolored, with no additional objects or details, and the artist's signature appears in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Bank (Dove)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
